description: Standard ACMG/AMP variant classification criteria thresholds
reference: Richards et al. 2015, ACMG/AMP Standards and Guidelines

population_frequency.description: Allele frequency thresholds for benign/pathogenic evidence
population_frequency.op_note: Each threshold carries an explicit 'op'. VCEPs differ on whether a threshold is inclusive (GALT states BA1/BS1/PM2 as >= / <=; SLC6A8 v2.1 flipped strict to inclusive), so a variant sitting exactly on a boundary depends on it. VCEP overrides may restate 'op'.

BA1.note: Allele frequency too high for penetrant disorder

BS1.note: May need adjustment based on disease prevalence

PM2_supporting.note: Per 2018 SVI recommendation, PM2 at supporting level

PM2_moderate.description: Very rare for moderate evidence - AF < 0.001%
PM2_moderate.note: Can be elevated to moderate if extremely rare

polyphen2.description: Score >= probably_damaging is damaging, < possibly is benign

spliceai.note: Max of DS_AG, DS_AL, DS_DG, DS_DL

PP3.description: Multiple computational tools support deleterious effect

BP4.description: Multiple computational tools suggest no impact

BP7.description: Silent variant with no predicted splice impact

nmd_considerations.note: Variants in last exon or within 55bp of last splice junction may escape NMD

likely_benign.description: Likely Benign if net points -6 to -9

benign.description: Benign if net points <= -10 OR BA1 met

pathogenic.rule: 1 Very Strong AND 1 Moderate AND 1 Supporting

PVS1.description: Null variant in gene where LOF is established mechanism of disease

PS1.description: Same amino acid change as previously established pathogenic variant
